title: InKeyAll
description: InKeyAll is a professional, high-performance Minecraft plugin that automates community engagement through repeating timed rewards and player-count milestones.
body:
# InKeyAll
InKeyAll is a Minecraft plugin that boosts player engagement by automating "KeyAll" rewards and community-driven milestones.

## Core Functions
- Timed KeyAlls: Create unlimited repeating rewards with unique intervals and permissions. Whether it is a daily reward or a VIP event, the plugin handles the timing automatically.
- Community Goals: Automatically reward the entire server when player-count milestones are reached. This incentivizes players to invite friends and stay online.
- Dynamic /goals Command: Provides a fully customizable, multi-line interface for players to track server progress in real-time.
- PlaceholderAPI Support: Includes integrated timers and milestone counters that can be displayed on Scoreboards, Tab lists, or Holograms.
- Smart Logic: Built-in cooldowns and reload-handling ensure that rewards are distributed fairly and prevent abuse after server restarts.
## Why Choose InKeyAll?
Unlike basic reward scripts, InKeyAll offers a dual-placeholder system. It features Internal Placeholders (like %online% and %required%) for easy configuration of in-game messages, and External Placeholders (like %inkeyall_timer_<id>%) for universal compatibility with other plugins via PlaceholderAPI. This ensures a seamless experience for both server administrators and players.

## Commands
- /goals - View current community goal progress.
- /inkeyall reload - Instantly reload configurations without a server restart.
- /inkeyall <id> - Manually trigger a specific KeyAll event.
## Installation
1. Download the InKeyAll.jar.
2. Place the file into your server's /plugins/ folder.
3. Restart your server to generate the default configuration.
4. Customize your rewards in the config.yml and run /inkeyall reload.
